scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run dev --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.pack: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run pack --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.gate:smoke:large-file: npm run rebuild:test && vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/services/modules/TMModule.test.ts -t "scans segments page by page"
scripts.gate:check: npm run docs:check && npm run gate:text && npm run format:check && npm run test:scripts && npm run ai-prompts:check && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/desktop && npm run gate:arch && npm run gate:style && npm run gate:file-size && npm run lint && npm run gate:smoke:large-file
scripts.test:db-schema: npm run rebuild:test && vitest run packages/db/src/currentSchema.test.ts packages/db/src/index.test.ts
scripts.build:cli: npm run build --workspace=packages/localization && npm run build --workspace=apps/cli
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown AGENTS.md README.md package.json .eslintrc.json .prettierrc.json .momocat-smoke.example.json vitest.config.ts "DOCS/**/*.md" "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,json}" "apps/*/package.json" "packages/*/package.json" apps/cli/README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown AGENTS.md README.md package.json .eslintrc.json .prettierrc.json .momocat-smoke.example.json vitest.config.ts "DOCS/**/*.md" "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,json}" "apps/*/package.json" "packages/*/package.json" apps/cli/README.md
